data.narrative:
Astro Mechanica is a Series A stage company in the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector, founded by Ian Brooke, having raised $27M+ to date. The addressable comp universe consists of two public peers (trading under DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS) and two private peers (Boom Supersonic and Hermeus), though the narrow stage-and-valuation specificity of this sector limits direct comparable analysis.

Given the absence of sufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage peers with adequate data density, the peer-median method is not applicable—the sector contains only two comparable companies, below the three-datapoint threshold required for reliable median triangulation. Accordingly, valuation relies on the stage-progression method, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression to the $27M total raised as a proxy base. This yields an implied valuation of $54M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $46M to $62M, centered on $54M. The median estimate carries material uncertainty given the single-method foundation and the nascent, heterogeneous nature of the supersonic/hypersonic competitive landscape. Key risk factors include stage-progression multiplier variance across this frontier sector and the absence of granular revenue or customer traction data in the submission. Validation would benefit from direct peer fundraising rounds and customer-backed revenue milestones as the sector matures.
